Measure the operating value of O.C element of each 
setting tap when C.B failure initiation contact is closed
Criteria : Operating value Less than 50% of 
setting
Resetting value More than 90 % of setting
Condition : Setting tap 0.05 + 0.15 A (R.B), 0.05 + 0.05 A (N)
Input current 200 % x setting
Operating time : Measure the time after CB failure
initiation contact is closed
Resetting time : Measure the time after CB failure
initiation contact is opened
Criteria : Operating time setting value 10 ms
Resetting time less than 20 ms
